name: Alice
source: A samba dancer from Brazil who met Daisy while travelling. Charismatic and warm, she disarms even the most serious people with her smile. She happened to be near Daisy's city for a special performance, and that coincidence turned into something more permanent. She brings rhythm and energy to the group even in its darkest moments.
